user_query: I'm a teacher and need to verify the email addresses of my students.

TaskList.description: Collect the list of student email addresses that need to be verified.
Validate the collected email addresses using the Quick Email Verification tool to check if they are valid and belong to real people.
Submit the batch of email addresses to the Blaze Verify API for status checking of the verification job.
Retrieve and analyze the status and results of the email verification job from the Blaze Verify API.
